description: This file contains utility functions for building challenge previews and test runners in the FreeCodeCamp project, including functions to get test runners, update previews, and determine challenge types.

methods.name: getTestRunner
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a test runner function based on challenge data.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Updates the challenge preview iframe if the challenge supports preview.

methods.name: getDocumentTitle
methods.description: Extracts the document title from challenge source HTML for accessibility.

methods.name: updateProjectPreview
methods.description: Updates the project preview iframe if the challenge supports preview.

methods.name: challengeHasPreview
methods.description: Determines if a challenge type supports preview rendering.

methods.name: isJavaScriptChallenge
methods.description: Checks if a challenge type is a JavaScript challenge.
